description: Sixty items need shooting against a clean backdrop and retouching so colours are true. Consistency across the set matters more than artistry.

title: Take the admin off my plate
description: I am drowning in my inbox and calendar. I need someone reliable to triage messages, arrange calls across time zones and keep our records tidy.

title: Keep our books straight and close each month
description: Match our bank lines against what the shops recorded, keep the ledger tidy and give us a short monthly summary of where the money went.
